ex.t: A proposal should include aims and costs.
The benefits of this plan are clear.
Risk factors must be identified in advance.
We will implement the plan in stages.

title.ko: 제안서: We propose that · It is recommended that · The proposal aims to
title.en: proposals and recommendations: we propose, it is recommended that, the proposal aims to

explain.ko: 제안서(proposal)는 문제를 진단하고 해결책을 제시하며 실행을 설득하는 글입니다. 구조는 목적, 현황, 제안, 이점과 위험, 일정, 결론 순서가 일반적입니다. 제안은 We propose (that) ..., It is recommended that ..., The proposal aims to ... 같은 격식 있는 문형을 사용하고, 가정법 현재(be, 동사원형)가 자주 쓰입니다. 비용과 일정, 위험을 구체적으로 밝히면 설득력이 높아집니다.
explain.en: A proposal diagnoses a problem, suggests a solution and persuades the reader to act. A typical structure is aim, current situation, proposal, benefits and risks, timeline, conclusion. Use formal patterns such as We propose (that) ..., It is recommended that ... and The proposal aims to ..., often with the subjunctive (be, base verb). Concrete costs, timelines and risks make it more convincing.

notes.en: Keep the proposal concise so decision-makers can judge easily.
State costs, timelines and risks concretely with numbers.

notes.en: State benefits first and pair risks with mitigation.

items.passage:
PROPOSAL
Opening an in-house cafe
We propose opening an in-house cafe to provide staff with a place to relax. The initial cost is around ten million won and can be recovered within two years from operating income. The main risk is that staff use may be low. To prevent this, we recommend a demand survey beforehand.

prompt.ko: 직장이나 학교의 개선안을 목적·방안·위험·권고 순으로 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write a four-sentence proposal for a workplace or school improvement: aim, option, risk, recommendation.

task.model: This proposal aims to improve the in-house training programme. We propose the introduction of a monthly online workshop. The main risk is low staff participation, so a prior survey is needed. Given the budget, we recommend a pilot followed by phased expansion.

model_trans.ko: 본 제안서는 사내 교육 프로그램의 개선을 목표로 합니다. 우리는 월 1회 온라인 워크숍의 도입을 제안합니다. 가장 큰 위험은 직원의 참여율 저하이므로 사전 설문이 필요합니다. 예산을 고려하여 시범 운영 후 단계적으로 확대할 것을 권고합니다.
model_trans.en: This proposal aims to improve the in-house training programme. We propose the introduction of a monthly online workshop. The main risk is low staff participation, so a prior survey is needed. Given the budget, we recommend a pilot followed by phased expansion.
